programme.title: Tomboy
programme.desc: Tori has always been one of the guys, but since her recent attempt to become more lady-like, she finds herself torn between a man who's fallen for her new femininity and a friend who loves her for the tomboy she's always been.

programme.title: A Soldier's Love Story
programme.desc: A divorcée (Lori Loughlin) falls for a soldier (Johnny Messner) who has become a mentor to her son while home on leave. Despite their mutual attraction, the pair are hesitant to start a romance in light of the soldier's upcoming deployment overseas. Harvey Frost directed.

programme.title: By Dawn's Early Light
programme.desc: A spoiled L.A. teen spends the summer in rural Colorado with his grandfather who decides to teach the boy a lesson by taking him on an 800-mile horseback ride.

programme.title: Reluctant Nanny
programme.desc: A lone officer desperately seeks a nanny for two children awaiting foster care, while Libby, jobless in LA, grapples with her future. Their paths cross due to a petty theft.

programme.title: Late Bloomer
programme.desc: Botanist Jenny fled her small town and cruel high school couple Shane and Allison to track rare flowers around the globe. Now back, she's shocked to find Shane has become a teacher and even more surprised when he's determined to make it up to her.

programme.title: Casa Vita
programme.desc: An Iowa farmer who moved to LA to attend a major league baseball camp romances the chef at the restaurant where he works. His future looks bright until an injury threatens his dream.

programme.title: Sweet Surrender
programme.desc: After spending years in the military, a young man returns to his hometown to take over operation of his ailing grandmother's bed-and-breakfast, where he must contend with an old flame who's scheming to get the property turned into a mall.

programme.title: Rescuing Madison
programme.desc: After a fireman saves the life of a pop-music star, a romance is sparked, but her former boyfriend is finding it hard to let go.

programme.title: Mechanics of Love
programme.desc: Mattie, a tech entrepreneur who is home for her sisters wedding runs into Jake, a childhood friend who complicates her life.

programme.title: Love's Unending Legacy
programme.desc: Missie three years later: being a single mother after her husband Willie was shot during a poker scuffle. She and Maddy move back in with her parents Clark and Marty. She finds a new home, and finds a new teaching position that she settles right into, but Missie has lost all faith in herself, until a chance encounter at her father's church where she adopts homeless orphan Belinda Marshall.

programme.title: A Place Called Home
programme.desc: Sentimental tale of a proud widow (Ann-Margret) whose deteriorating sight impels her to take in a drifter (Matthew Settle) and his precocious daughter (Shailene Woodley). Gary Sandy, Hunter Tylo. Jan Kyles: Rebecca McFarland. Dave Jeeters: Sean O'Bryan. Sheriff Gorman: Christopher Murray.

programme.title: Love's Unfolding Dream
programme.desc: The sixth installment of the "Love Comes Softly" series follows the now-grown Belinda Tyler (Scout Taylor-Compton) as she struggles to choose between her career aspirations as a doctor and her feelings for a New York lawyer who wants a traditional wife. Clark: Dale Midkiff. Missie: Erin Cottrell.

programme.title: Grand Champion
programme.desc: Stock heart-warmer about a preteen cowboy (Jacob Fisher) and his prize steer on a quest to win a prestigious cattle show in Texas. Joey Lauren Adams, Cache Williams. Written and directed by Barry Tubb, the film features cameos by Bruce Willis and Julia Roberts (whose husband, Daniel Moder, handles the cinematography), and country stars George Strait, Robert Earl Keen and Natalie Maines, of the Dixie Chicks.

programme.title: Vickery's Wild Ride
programme.desc: A successful ad man (Jonathan Silverman) tries to reconnect with his family by taking them on a monthlong vacation to a rustic cabin that he recently inherited. Though resistant at first, the family start to enjoy themselves after meeting a cowboy (Peter Strauss) who teaches them about life's simpler pleasures.

programme.title: Love Finds a Home
programme.desc: Dr. Belinda Owens (Sarah Jones) cares for her pregnant friend, whose opinionated mother-in-law (Patty Duke) resists Belinda's scientific approach to medicine. Adding to Belinda's worries is her own desire, but seeming inability, to become pregnant. Haylie Duff and Jordan Bridges also star. Based on the novel by Janette Oke.

programme.desc: Romance blooms between a single mom and an injured firefighter who is renting a room in her home while he recovers. Though her kids are instantly taken with him, the woman has doubts about the wisdom of starting a new relationship.

programme.title: A Taste of Romance
programme.desc: A classically trained chef (Teri Polo) feels the heat of competition when a retired fireman (James Patrick Stuart) opens a restaurant next to hers. Though they clash initially, the pair soon strike up a friendship with help from the man's precocious daughter (Bailee Madison). Directed by Lee Rose.

programme.title: Bound by a Secret
programme.desc: Dying actress Jane (Leslie Ann Warren) returns to her hometown to spend her final days with her best friend, Ida Mae (Meredith Baxter). Their respite hits a snag, though, when Jane decides to reveal that she's the biological mother of Ida Mae's daughter (Bridget Ann White). Timothy Bottoms also stars. Directed by David S. Cass Sr.

programme.desc: Slice of Americana about the impact of WWII on a Southern hamlet. Barnard Hughes. Pastine: Sada Thompson. Rosh: Robert Prosky. Henry: Bill Pullman. Francine: Elizabeth Berridge. Lonnie: Neil Patrick Harris. Billy: Kyle Chandler. Hilton: Wallace Wilkinson. Filmed in Georgia. Adapted by Robert Inman from his novel. Directed by Glenn Jordan.

programme.title: Uncorked
programme.desc: A workaholic (Julie Benz) finds herself in unfamiliar territory after her schedule unexpectedly clears during a business trip to California's wine country. She starts spending time with a local chef (Scott Elrod) and his eccentric family, who try to teach her that there's more to life than work. JoBeth Williams and Elliott Gould also star. Directed by David Cass Sr.

programme.title: Return to Sender
programme.desc: When a weathered old envelope appears in the mailbox of Meg's new apartment marked Return to Sender, she joins the building manager Ollie along with podcaster Ellen and partner Pete to find out who sent this mysterious love letter.

programme.title: Time Capsule
programme.desc: After 10 years, a group of high school friends reunite at their alma mater's field house to dig up their time capsule. When they open the time capsule they decide to relive their fun high school moments which inspire a newfound relationship.

programme.desc: A rich law student (Justin Bruening) must help a single mom (Jodi Lyn O'Keefe) find a job with benefits as part of an assignment for his public-advocacy class. Though the pair clash at first, they soon realize they aren't so different and that they each need to go after the careers they truly want. Directed by Dave S. Cass Sr.

programme.title: Tomboy
programme.desc: Tori has always been one of the guys, but since her recent attempt to become more lady-like, she finds herself torn between a man who's fallen for her new femininity and a friend who loves her for the tomboy she's always been.

programme.title: By Dawn's Early Light
programme.desc: A spoiled L.A. teen spends the summer in rural Colorado with his grandfather who decides to teach the boy a lesson by taking him on an 800-mile horseback ride.

programme.title: A Place Called Home
programme.desc: Sentimental tale of a proud widow (Ann-Margret) whose deteriorating sight impels her to take in a drifter (Matthew Settle) and his precocious daughter (Shailene Woodley). Gary Sandy, Hunter Tylo. Jan Kyles: Rebecca McFarland. Dave Jeeters: Sean O'Bryan. Sheriff Gorman: Christopher Murray.

programme.title: Sweet Surrender
programme.desc: After spending years in the military, a young man returns to his hometown to take over operation of his ailing grandmother's bed-and-breakfast, where he must contend with an old flame who's scheming to get the property turned into a mall.

programme.title: A Soldier's Love Story
programme.desc: A divorcée (Lori Loughlin) falls for a soldier (Johnny Messner) who has become a mentor to her son while home on leave. Despite their mutual attraction, the pair are hesitant to start a romance in light of the soldier's upcoming deployment overseas. Harvey Frost directed.

programme.title: Back to You and Me
programme.desc: In this romantic tearjerker, an angst-ridden doctor (Lisa Hartman Black) returns home to attend a high-school reunion---and to mend fences with loved ones she left behind. Helen: Rue McClanahan. Gus: Dale Midkiff. Nelson: Larry Manetti.

programme.title: Rescuing Madison
programme.desc: After a fireman saves the life of a pop-music star, a romance is sparked, but her former boyfriend is finding it hard to let go.

programme.title: Gentle Ben 2: Black Gold
programme.desc: In this sequel, the use of land abutting the wilderness sparks conflict for Fog (who owns the land) and Jack. Rather than drill for oil, Fog says he'll open a natural spring-water business, but Jack doesn't believe him, and ends up being jailed for sabotaging the operation.

programme.title: The Michaels
programme.desc: A manicurist predicts that an unlucky-at-love lawyer will meet the love of her life and he will be a Michael, so the attorney begins a series of dates with men with that name.

programme.title: 2025 Stanley Cup Final

programme.title: 2025 Stanley Cup Final
programme.desc: The Oilers try to press their advantage as they host the Panthers for Game 2 of the Stanley Cup Final. Leon Draisaitl's second goal of Game 1 came on the power play with 31 seconds remaining in the first overtime frame for a 4-3 Edmonton win.

programme.title: 2025 Stanley Cup Final
programme.desc: The 2025 Stanley Cup Final, tied at 1-1, takes the Panthers and Oilers to Florida for Game 3. After Corey Perry scored with 18 seconds left to tie the game, Brad Marchand broke hearts with his double-overtime tally to give Florida a 5-4 Game 2 win.

programme.title: 2025 Stanley Cup Final
programme.desc: The Panthers try to put a stranglehold on their Stanley Cup Final with the Oilers in this Game 4. Brad Marchand scored another key goal in Game 3, striking in the opening minute as Florida cruised to a 6-1 victory and a 2-1 series advantage.

programme.title: 2025 Stanley Cup Final
programme.desc: The Stanley Cup Final returns north, with the Oilers and Panthers playing Game 5 tied at 2-2. A seesaw duel saw Florida's Sam Reinhart send Game 4 to overtime with 20 seconds left, but Leon Draisaitl scored after 11 minutes for a 5-4 Edmonton win.

programme.title: 2025 Stanley Cup Final
programme.desc: The Panthers aim to claim their second straight Stanley Cup in Game 6 against the Oilers. Florida made an early 2-0 lead in Game 5 hold up for an eventual 5-2 victory over Edmonton. Brad Marchand scored the first and third goals for the Panthers.

programme.desc: The story of Jesse Brown, the first Black aviator in Navy history, and fellow fighter pilot Tom Hudner. Helping to turn the tide in the Korean War's most brutal battle, their heroic sacrifices ultimately make them the Navy's most celebrated wingmen.

programme.title: Turtles All the Way Down
programme.desc: It´s not easy being Aza, but she´s trying to be a good daughter, a good friend, and a good student, all while navigating an endless barrage of invasive, obsessive thoughts that she cannot control.

programme.title: Expend4bles
programme.desc: Armed with every weapon they can get their hands on, the Expendables are the world's last line of defense and the team that gets called when all other options are off the table.

programme.title: Race for Glory: Audi vs. Lancia
programme.desc: The true story of the intense race car rivalry between Germany and Italy at the 1983 Rally World Championship.

programme.title: Kraven the Hunter
programme.desc: Kraven's complex relationship with his ruthless father starts him down a path of vengeance, motivating him to become not only the greatest hunter in the world, but also one of its most feared.

programme.title: Beba
programme.desc: A young NYC born and bred Afro-Latina stares down historical, societal, and generational trauma with unflinching courage.

programme.title: Cinéma
programme.desc: Emerging Montreal drag queen Simon must deal with two impossible loves: a passionate, yet destructive affair, with Oliver and a cold relationship with his mother, who's just returned after a 15-year absence.

programme.title: Corner Gas
programme.desc: Brent and Lacey sponsor Davis' football team; Karen's reckless driving puts Hank in the driver's seat.

programme.title: Corner Gas
programme.desc: Brent offers self-serve; Lacey goes buffet style at the Ruby.

programme.title: Transplant
programme.desc: Dr. Bishop puts extra pressure on Bash, while Theo feels powerless when something happens to one of his daughters back home; a patient puts Mags' moral convictions to the test and June tries to improve her social skills.

programme.title: Merry Swissmas
programme.desc: While spending Christmastime with her mother in Switzerland, an architect meets a single father who shows her how to open herself up to love and forgiveness during the holiday season.

programme.title: Movie
programme.desc: Movie to be announced.

programme.title: Jurassic World
programme.desc: An ex-military man and animal expert must use his special skills to save tourists at the Jurassic World island resort from rampaging, genetically engineered dinosaurs, including the vicious and intelligent Indominus rex.

programme.title: I Am Alfred Hitchcock
programme.desc: Interviews and archival footage weave together to tell the story of the Master of Suspense, one of the most influential and studied filmmakers in the history of cinema.

programme.title: Aurora Teagarden Mysteries
programme.desc: Aurora's boyfriend, Martin, reconnects with his long-lost niece, but she departs suddenly, leaving a dead husband on a balcony and a baby in a bathtub.

programme.title: Harold and the Purple Crayon
programme.desc: Inside his book, Harold can make anything come to life simply by drawing it. After he grows up and draws himself off the book's pages and into the real world, he learns his trusty crayon can set off more hilarious hijinks than he thought possible.

programme.title: The Watchers
programme.desc: A 28-year-old artist gets stranded in an expansive, untouched forest in western Ireland. Finding shelter, she unknowingly becomes trapped alongside three strangers who are stalked by mysterious creatures every night.

programme.title: The Courier
programme.desc: Recruited by MI6, British businessman Greville Wynne works with Soviet spy Oleg Penkovsky to obtain intelligence on the Cuban Missile Crisis.

programme.title: Alarum
programme.desc: Living off the grid while vacationing at a winter resort, married spies Joe and Lara come under fire from members of the old guard who suspect they've joined an elite team of rogue spies.

programme.title: The Players
programme.desc: Summer. 1994. Emily is cast as the youngest member of an avant garde theatre production. She is immediately entranced by the bohemian lives of her fellow actors and feels like she has found a surrogate family.

programme.title: Horizon: An American Saga: Chapter 1
programme.desc: In 1859 families discover the lure of the Old West as they settle in territories from Wyoming to Kansas. Meanwhile, a gruff cowboy soon finds himself on the run with a prostitute and a young boy after killing a fellow gunman.

programme.title: Beating Hearts
programme.desc: Clotaire falls for his schoolmate Jackie, charmed by her fearless spirit and sharp wit. As first love blossoms between the two, gang violence entices him into a darker path and destroys everything when he is charged with a crime he didn't commit.

programme.title: Corner Gas
programme.desc: The air conditioner breaks at Corner Gas; Karen and Davis win the meat lottery.

programme.title: Corner Gas
programme.sub-title: All That and a Bag of Chips
programme.desc: Karen's reputation as a woman of the law is marred when an accidental muffin incident causes chaos for the team.

programme.title: Transplant
programme.desc: Bash does his best to celebrate Eid with his sister Amira, but she wishes they could continue the traditions they had back home; Theo treats a teenage patient who wants to avoid telling his parents why he's in the hospital.

programme.title: Ice Quake
programme.desc: Michael (Brendan Fehr), a military geologist, takes his family hiking in Alaska. After a series of earthquakes opens fissures and geysers in the ice, Michael realizes a greater catastrophe may be looming.

programme.title: The Curious Case of Dolphin Bay
programme.desc: A group of friends are spending the summer working as interns at a research center, which is researching unnatural changes in the local reef. After strange events begin to occur, the friends suspect a local legend may be tied to the reef's problems.

programme.title: Camp Cold Brook
programme.desc: Strange events plague crew members of a reality TV show when they visit an infamous backwoods camp that was the site of a mass murder 20 years earlier.

programme.title: Twister Valley
programme.desc: Two sisters remain haunted by a tornado that changed their lives 25 years earlier.

programme.title: Princes of the Desert
programme.desc: Zodi, a young Berber boy, befriends an orphaned baby camel and together, they journey across the Sahara Desert.

programme.title: Storm Seekers
programme.desc: Scientists study the effects of global warming on hurricane frequency and strength.

programme.title: Nelly Knows Mysteries: A Fatal Engagement
programme.desc: When Dahlia's boyfriend is found dead, advice columnist Nelly joins Detective Hogan to help find the killer. However, as suspicions creep in, Dahlia becomes the prime suspect.

programme.title: Monster
programme.desc: A single mother demands answers from a school teacher when her son begins acting strangely. A fight at school causes even more trouble.

programme.title: Dark Side of Comedy
programme.desc: Artie Lange enjoys mainstream success as a comedian, but his addiction to heroin, coupled with childhood traumas, threatens to thwart his ambition and life.

programme.title: We're All Gonna Die (Even Jay Baruchel)
programme.desc: Jay Baruchel meets his fascination with the apocalypse head-on, as he explores, from a place of genuine curiosity and wonder, various ways humanity could possibly meet its doom.

programme.title: Darkest Miriam
programme.desc: Grieving Miriam works at a city library. Her quiet life changes when she starts a new romance and receives threatening letters, disrupting her routine.

programme.title: Being Maria
programme.desc: Maria, on the cusp of adulthood, stars in the cult classic "Last Tango in Paris." Unprepared, she's thrust into fame, becoming an iconic actress amidst glory and scandal.

programme.title: Small Things Like These
programme.desc: In 1985 coal merchant Bill Furlong uncovers disturbing secrets in a small Irish town that's controlled by the Roman Catholic Church.
